svg.text: How astSimplify collapses a CmpMap: 8 atomic Mappings → 3
Fixture ast_tester/simplify_fixtures/cap_specmap_07.map — a 1-D spectral axis Mapping. Every state below was traced from Simplify() in src/cmpmap.c.
the engine, from Simplify() in src/cmpmap.c
an inverted CmpMap contributes its components in reverse
order, each with its Invert flag flipped
the unit-form matrix passes astIsDiagonal, so WinDiagMat folds it into the window — no change to the numbers · 8 → 7
WinDiagMat again: the diagonal term −1703.30 multiplies both the scale and the shift · 7 → 6
the UnitMap branch of WinMap's MapMerge simply clones the WinMap and drops the neighbour · 6 → 5
WinWin composes the two windows into one: −1703.30 × −587.10 = 1.0000e6 · 5 → 4
slot #0 is re-nominated once more and astMapMerge now
returns −1, so the sweep finally advances to slot #1
nominate #1 · inverted SpecMap rewrites itself forward
the conversion steps are re-expanded in reverse, each swapped for its complement: (VOTOVL, VLTOFR)⁻¹ = FRTOVL, VLTOVO · 4 → 4, list length unchanged
a UnitMap counts as zoom 1 in ZoomMap's adjacent-run scan; the inverted factor 1000 becomes 0.001 · 4 → 3
Each merge reports modified = 0, which is less than the
already-incremented nominated, so the sweep resets to
slot 0 and tries again. The pointer only moves on once
The outer loop runs once more over all three slots. WinMap, SpecMap and ZoomMap each return −1 from astMapMerge,
so improved stays 0 and the loop exits. A fixed point always costs one extra pass that changes nothing.
The list is rebuilt right to left into nested CmpMaps, and the surviving WinMap carries
the whole linear part of the original chain.
Traced by instrumenting the astMapMerge call in Simplify() (src/cmpmap.c); WinMap scale and shift values verified against cap_specmap_07.simp.
